listing.name: Superheavy booster engine layout - Stock
listing.abstract: A configuration of tanks and engines that mimick the layout of the Super Heavy booster in real life.
listing.description: Not a full rocket and certainly not a recreation of Supeheavy. it is just tanks configured to support 33 engines symmetrically in the same layout as Superheavy, with the stock LR-91 Sea engines installed. Scale is mostly accurate, it's like 10m wide or something.
